method: Map immediate caller argument values from Update0014 positional evidence into the exact supplied PE images. Classify nulls, signed sentinels, in-module addresses, small scalars, and external/large values. Decode only NUL-terminated printable ASCII at proven mapped addresses.
interpretation_limits: An in-module address proves pointer provenance, not pointee type or parameter declaration.
Printable ASCII proves string bytes at that address, not host ownership or format semantics.
External or large values may be scalars or addresses outside the module and remain untyped.
Exact host prototypes still require Worldgroup binaries, symbols, headers, or dynamic traces.
